Location A2: “The kit prevents all delays.” → “The kit may reduce packing delays.”

Smallest meaningful change: the outcome claim is qualified and narrowed from preventing all delays to possibly reducing packing delays.

Rationale: Style rule S1 requires qualification of outcomes that are not guaranteed. Evidence note E1 reports fewer packing delays in the trial but did not test other delays. Source: E1.

Protection: the protected quotation at A3, “Pack light.”, is unchanged; protection preserved.

Decision status: approved.

Unresolved impact: the supplied record does not establish effects on delays other than packing delays, so no broader impact is assessed.
